note: Extracted by hand from both size bands of the 978M sheet, folded into one grammar. The seat prints PEEK or Teflon with no hard seat row on this sheet, unlike the 978. The blocks are the sheet's own pre-combined codes with the slashed zeros carried as plain zeros and the ZZZZZZ non-standard rows kept, each block held to its printed size. The single 1H actuator row prints 0.50 to 0.75 on the small pages and 1-1/2 to 2 on the large, one code with both readings in its label. Position 11 and 12 prints SEP compliance 0G on the small pages and PED compliance 0E on the large, held to their own size bands.
